title: My Face on the Astronaut
tests: Tests recognizable source identity, natural face blending and preservation of the supplied poster.

faults.what: The swapped face has noticeably wider-open eyes and slightly parted lips compared with the portrait, making the likeness a little less faithful.

judge.summary: The woman is recognizable inside the astronaut helmet, with the original poster preserved, though her eyes and expression are slightly altered.

must_haves.item: The astronaut's face is recognizably the woman from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The eyebrows, nose, lips and overall facial appearance retain a recognizable likeness despite some changes to eye shape and expression.

must_haves.item: The replacement face fits inside the open helmet without conspicuous seams or doubled features.
must_haves.why: The face sits naturally within the helmet opening, with no conspicuous cutout edges or duplicated features.

must_haves.item: The original white suit, helmet and star background remain intact.
must_haves.why: The suit details, helmet structure, reflections and surrounding star field are preserved.

must_haves.item: The result retains the retro poster look and vertical composition.
must_haves.why: The tall framing, aged cream border and original poster coloring remain intact.
